title: Outsourcing facility registration: the inspection requirement, the odd-year term, renewal and the limited renewal of a provisional registration
subtopic: Outsourcing facility registration term and renewal
rule_summary: Under M.G.L. c. 112, s. 36E(b) an applicant located within the commonwealth for registration as an outsourcing facility provides proof of a valid, current FDA registration under section 503B of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, of inspection by the FDA in connection with that registration within the 2 years immediately preceding the application, and of application and eligibility for registration to manufacture or distribute controlled substances under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 12; an applicant meeting the first and third requirements but not inspected within the 2 years may receive a provisional registration to compound, but may not distribute a sterile drug preparation within or outside the commonwealth until it has been inspected. 247 CMR 21.02(3)(d) and (e) require the same proof of FDA registration and FDA inspection for a Massachusetts outsourcing facility registration. Under s. 36E(d) and 247 CMR 21.05 an outsourcing facility registration and a non-resident outsourcing facility registration expire on December 31st of each odd numbered year following issuance, renewal is made in the form and manner determined by the Board, and the renewal applicant submits proof of a valid, current FDA 503B registration, payment, and any additional information the Board requires. Under 247 CMR 21.03(6) a provisional outsourcing facility registration issued on or after September 1st of an odd numbered year may be renewed, and no other provisional outsourcing facility registration may be renewed or extended; under 21.03(7) a provisional outsourcing facility registration is non-transferrable. Under 247 CMR 21.09(4) and (5) a registrant shall notify the Board in writing within 14 days of an inspection by the FDA and of receipt of an FDA Form 483 or Warning Letter.
exam_relevance: Tests the single exception that allows a provisional outsourcing registration to be renewed, and the FDA-inspection proof that separates a full registration from a provisional one.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.fact: FDA inspection look-back for a full outsourcing facility registration

numeric_facts.value: December 31st of each odd numbered year following issuance

numeric_facts.fact: Earliest issue date from which a provisional outsourcing registration may be renewed
numeric_facts.value: September 1st of an odd numbered year
numeric_facts.conditions: issued on or after that date; no other provisional registration may be renewed or extended

numeric_facts.fact: Notice to the Board of an FDA inspection, Form 483 or Warning Letter

exceptions: A provisional outsourcing facility registration issued on or after September 1st of an odd numbered year may be renewed.
common_confusions: Unlike a provisional pharmacy licence under 247 CMR 6.17, a provisional outsourcing registration runs to December 31st of the first odd numbered year after issue and, if issued on or after September 1st of an odd numbered year, may be renewed.
Renewal of a full registration requires proof of a current FDA 503B registration, not a new FDA inspection.

M.G.L. c. 112, s. 36E(b) says a provisional registrant may not distribute a sterile drug preparation until inspected; 247 CMR 21.03(3) says it may not distribute or dispense one until inspected by the FDA and registered in Massachusetts, so the regulation names dispensing as well.
